description: Disposable Jenkins lab fixtures for MCP triage, diagnose, compare, and regression drills.

jobs.name: mock-inv-baseline-green
jobs.scenario: Multi-stage green baseline for compare_builds and regression windows

jobs.name: mock-inv-regression-broken
jobs.scenario: Same shape as baseline-green but Test stage fails (regression compare target)

jobs.name: mock-inv-compile-failure
jobs.scenario: Compile stage fails with compiler-style errors before tests run

jobs.name: mock-inv-test-failure
jobs.scenario: Build passes; JUnit reports multiple failures

jobs.name: mock-inv-unstable
jobs.scenario: Non-fatal stage failure marked UNSTABLE; pipeline continues to Publish

jobs.name: mock-inv-nested-stages
jobs.scenario: Nested stage groups; failure deep in Integration child stage

jobs.name: mock-inv-parallel-mixed
jobs.scenario: Parallel branches: one green, one npm-style failure

jobs.name: mock-inv-long-log
jobs.scenario: Emits ~500 log lines for progressive tail and budget testing

jobs.name: mock-inv-post-failure
jobs.scenario: Main stage fails; post { always } still runs cleanup lines

jobs.name: mock-inv-multi-artifact
jobs.scenario: Archives multiple small artifacts for list/inspect flows

jobs.name: mock-inv-build-graph-downstream
jobs.scenario: Leaf pipeline for upstream/downstream related-build graph drills

jobs.name: mock-inv-queue-blocked
jobs.scenario: Build stays queued (nonexistent agent label) for queue delay/pressure drills
